'''Karlheinz Steinmüller''' (born 4 November 1950) is a German physicist and [[science fiction]] author.<ref>{{cite book|last=Fritzsche|first=Sonja|title=Science Fiction Literature in East Germany|year=2006|publisher=Lang|location=Oxford and New York|page=241}}</ref> Together with his wife [[Angela Steinmüller]] he has written science fiction short stories and novels that depict human development on a cosmic scale, grounded in an analysis of social structures and mechanisms. Angela and Karlheinz Steinmüller were not only among the most widely read authors in the [[East Germany|GDR]], ranking at the top of a 1989 poll of most popular science fiction authors in the GDR,<ref>{{cite book|last=Steinmüller|first=Angela and Karlheinz|title=Vorgriff auf das Lichte Morgen|year=1995|publisher=Erster Deutscher Fantasy Club|location=Passau|page=174}}</ref> but their works continue to be republished.

==Awards==
* 1995: [[Kurd-Laßwitz-Preis]] "Best short story" for ''Leichter als Vakuum'' (with [[Angela Steinmüller]] and [[Erik Simon]])
* 2001:  German Fantasy Prize for ''die Verbreitung der phantastischen Literatur in zwei verschiedenen Gesellschaftssystemen sowie ihre Zukunftsperspektiven.'' (with Angela Steinmüller)
* 2004: Kurd-Laßwitz-Preis "Beste Kurzgeschichte" for ''Vor der Zeitreise'' (with Angela Steinmüller)

==Novels (with Angela Steinmüller)==

* ''[[Andymon|Andymon. Eine Weltraum-Utopie]]'', 1982
* ''Pulaster. Roman eines Planeten'', 1986
* ''[[Der Traummeister]]'', 1990
* ''Spera'', 2004
